subject: Joint evaluation: kickoff, roles & technical contact introduction
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karen Bishop <kbishop@stellardata.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Joint evaluation: kickoff, roles & technical contact introduction

Hi Karen —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. As discussed, I wanted to kick off a concise mutual action plan (MAP) to align stakeholders, the technical evaluation path, and a target close timeline. Draft attached.

Quick summary / proposal:
- Goal: Validate inference throughput and latency for StellarData's document ingestion pipeline; target POC close by end of Q3 (approx Sep 24).
- Redwood leads: Dylan Brooks (AM) — overall program owner; Marissa Cole (CS) — success/measurement; Dev Patel (SE) — technical lead for the proof-of-concept.
- StellarData leads: please confirm engineering owner and procurement contact.
- Proposed first milestone: Technical kickoff + environment scoping (this week).

Attachments: 20270814_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx (MAP milestones), redwood-eval-checklist.pdf (evaluation criteria + sample prompts).

Would you and your engineering lead be available for a 45-minute technical kickoff Tuesday 8/17 at 10:00 AM PT? If not, suggest two windows and we'll accommodate.

Agenda I suggest for the kickoff (30–45m):
1) Intros & success criteria (5m)
2) Architecture & data flow review — what StellarData will send, expected sequence lengths, PII considerations (10m)
3) Performance targets & rollout matrix (10m)
4) Test infra, roles, and action items (10m)

Next step: confirm Liam (or your engineering lead) and procurement contact; we’ll lock time and share the Drive doc and a lightweight JIRA board for tasks.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Manager, Redwood Inference

Thanks, Dylan — this looks good.

Introducing our engineering lead, Liam O'Connor (cc'ed at liam.oconnor@dataforge.ai). Liam will own the technical side and the test harness. Procurement for StellarData is handled by me initially; I'll loop in finance if we get to committed capacity.

The proposed timeline is fine — we are motivated to hit an end-of-September decision. Two quick notes before the kickoff:
- Our ingestion includes mixed-length documents; average tokens per document ~700, peak ~4k. Planning to sample the heavier docs in the POC.
- We will need to see evidence of data handling (audit logs + optional on-prem pattern) — SOC2 artifacts would be helpful.

8/17 at 10:00 AM PT works for Liam and me. Please send calendar invite and the Drive link.

-Karen

Subject: Re: Joint evaluation: kickoff, roles & technical contact introduction

Hi Liam & team — nice to meet you over email. Quick technical notes ahead of Tuesday's call: 

1) Test infra: we generally run two parallel experiments — throughput (sustained QPS) and tail latency (95/99th pct) — using a synthetic load that mirrors your average + peak token distributions. If you can drop a small sample set (anonymized) into the Drive folder I can pre-run a dry pass.

2) Data handling: I'll bring SOC2 artifact excerpts to the kickoff and we can schedule an optional security deep-dive with our compliance lead if needed.

3) Integration paths: we support API-based streaming + bulk batch ingestion via S3 connectors; if you have an existing S3 staging bucket we can point the POC at it.

Proposed kickoff checklist (I'll own the technical tasks):
- Confirm sample files (Liam)
- Share temporary S3 bucket or enable Drive drop (Liam)
- SE-run preflight (me)
- Quick security artifact packet (Marissa)

I've created a lightweight JIRA board for the POC: SUP-3421 (public view link in Drive). I'll post the test plan to the Drive doc before the call.

Thanks — looking forward to Tuesday.

Cheers,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

See you Tuesday.
